title: Microsoft Purview DLP: stop Copilot grounding on external emails
summary: The briefing passes: its licensing statements remain supported by the updated Purview service description, and its control, default state and rollout dates match Microsoft's documentation and notice. Two minor checklist inconsistencies remain: accepted-domain review and role assignment have no corresponding controls-table rows.

claims.where: title; front matter: summary, products, tags; What's changing
claims.claim: Microsoft is expanding Purview DLP with a real-time control to restrict processing external emails.
claims.quote: This real-time control helps organizations mitigate data risks by preventing Microsoft 365 Copilot and Chat from processing emails from senders external to your organization.

claims.quote: This feature is in preview. It applies to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat, including email summarization and reasoning experiences that use email data.

claims.claim: When enabled, the rule excludes external emails from referencing and citation.
claims.quote: When the policy detects that an email was received from a sender outside your organization's accepted domains, Copilot excludes that email from grounding, summarization, and citation.
